title: Oceanic Polish Seafood Fritters
description: A cultured Polish dish featuring seafood stock and deep-fried to a crispy golden brown, high in protein and perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Combine cod pieces, shrimp, seafood stock, and chopped onion in a large bowl.
Mix well and let it sit for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, eggs, melted butter, salt, and black pepper.
Add the dry ingredients to the seafood mixture and stir until just combined.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the mixture into the hot oil, about 1/4 cup each.
Do not overcrowd the pan, fry in batches if necessary.
Fry the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
